title: Shaidun da Suka Halaka
intro: A wani zamani mai tsawo, wata al'umma ta zauna a wani wuri mai haɗuwa tsakanin dauloli. Annabinsu ya kira su zuwa ga hanyar gaskiya, duk da haka sun manne da kafirci da zalunci. Wannan labarin ya ƙare da azabar Allah. Za ku iya gane wannan al'umma da makomarta daga alamun da ke ƙasa?
clues: Mutane sun ƙi gargaɗin da ɗaya daga cikin manzanninsu ya kawo.
Manzon ya kira mu mu bauta wa Allah shi kaɗai kuma ya yi gargaɗi game da ɓarna.
Laifinmu shine kin annabin da aka aiko a cikinmu da adalci.
Mun yi shakkar ikon manzon kuma muka tuhume shi da yaudara.
Hukuncin ya same mu yayin da muke zaune lafiya a gidajenmu.
An halaka mu saboda karyata annabinmu da kuma tsananta wa muminai.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Karɓar annabin da ya kira zuwa ga adalci
trial.answer: Karɓar annabin da ya kira zuwa ga adalci

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An halaka mutanen saboda rashin imani
Mutane sun tuba kuma an shiryar da su
Mutane sun tsira kuma sun ci gaba
Mutanen sun yi ƙaura zuwa sabuwar ƙasa
outcome.answer: An halaka mutanen saboda rashin imani

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
